tables.name: inventory_lifecycle_batches
columns: inventory_batch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
batch_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(batch_kind IN ('manual_bulk','proposal_acceptance','correction_bulk'))
target_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(target_count>0)
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: one independently addressable event/result per target remains mandatory
batch identity groups atomic intent but is never shared lifecycle truth

tables.name: inventory_proposals
columns: inventory_proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY

proposal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(proposal_kind IN ('spare_request_submission','official_sr7','rma_authorization','dispatch','receipt','fault_tag_submission','warehouse_received','warehouse_final_decision'))
evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL
evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL
source_proposal_key TEXT NOT NULL
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','accepted','rejected','superseded'))
input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64)
risk_tier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(risk_tier IN ('normal','high','material_final'))
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: proposal is non-authoritative until accepted
same evidence/source_proposal_key is idempotent
warehouse final decisions always material_final and require explicit operator confirmation

tables.name: inventory_proposal_targets
columns: inventory_proposal_target_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
inventory_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_proposals(inventory_proposal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
target_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(target_kind IN ('spare_request','rma','spare_part_unit','fault_tag','fault_tag_membership'))
spare_request_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rma_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES rmas(rma_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
spare_part_unit_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES spare_part_units(spare_part_unit_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
fault_tag_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES fault_tags(fault_tag_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
fault_tag_membership_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES fault_tag_memberships(fault_tag_membership_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_revision>0)
proposed_action TEXT NOT NULL
payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json))

CHECK((target_kind='spare_request' AND spare_request_id IS NOT NULL AND rma_id IS NULL AND spare_part_unit_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_membership_id IS NULL) OR (target_kind='rma' AND rma_id IS NOT NULL AND spare_request_id IS NULL AND spare_part_unit_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_membership_id IS NULL) OR (target_kind='spare_part_unit' AND spare_part_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND spare_request_id IS NULL AND rma_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_membership_id IS NULL) OR (target_kind='fault_tag' AND fault_tag_id IS NOT NULL AND spare_request_id IS NULL AND rma_id IS NULL AND spare_part_unit_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_membership_id IS NULL) OR (target_kind='fault_tag_membership' AND fault_tag_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND spare_request_id IS NULL AND rma_id IS NULL AND spare_part_unit_id IS NULL AND fault_tag_id IS NULL))
rules: payload_json belongs to closed INVENTORY_PROPOSAL_TARGET_V1 and contains only proposed typed facts, not message bodies
each target independently reviewable even when one evidence item supports many targets

tables.name: spare_request_current_projection
columns: spare_request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('draft','submitted_awaiting_response','acknowledged','partially_authorized','authorized','cancelled','rejected'))
official_sr7_known INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(official_sr7_known IN (0,1))
submitted_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(submitted_quantity>=0)
rma_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rma_count>=0)
response_warning_due_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(response_warning_due_utc IS NULL OR response_warning_due_utc>=0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: rebuildable from accepted submission/identifier/RMA/lifecycle evidence
24h response warning starts only from accepted submission chronology and never from MSG generation

tables.name: rma_current_projection
columns: rma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES rmas(rma_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('promised','dispatched','received','physical_consequence_pending','return_open','fault_tagged','warehouse_received','closed_accepted','return_rejected'))
target_device_part_unit_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES device_part_units(device_part_unit_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
direct_inbound_spare_part_unit_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES spare_part_units(spare_part_unit_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
return_device_part_unit_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES device_part_units(device_part_unit_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
return_spare_part_unit_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES spare_part_units(spare_part_unit_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
return_obligation_open INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(return_obligation_open IN (0,1))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK(NOT(return_device_part_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND return_spare_part_unit_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: rebuildable from identifier/assignment/receipt/consequence/return/Fault Tag/warehouse evidence
warehouse receipt never sets return_obligation_open=0
only accepted final warehouse decision closes obligation

tables.name: spare_part_unit_current_projection
columns: spare_part_unit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES spare_part_units(spare_part_unit_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
condition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(condition IN ('new','serviceable','faulty','incompatible','dismantled','scrapped','unknown'))
disposition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(disposition IN ('available','reserved','installed','quarantined','return_pending','returned','scrapped','dismantled_parent','unknown'))
custody_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(custody_kind IN ('local','dispatch_location','device','external_provider','warehouse','unknown'))
dispatch_location_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES dispatch_locations(dispatch_location_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
device_reference_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES device_references(device_reference_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
active_task_allocation_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_unit_allocations(task_unit_allocation_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
stock_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stock_eligible IN (0,1))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: stock_eligible is derived, never user-editable
reserved/installed/quarantined/return_pending/returned/scrapped/dismantled_parent are not eligible stock
later provenance adoption cannot change unit identity

tables.name: spare_need_current_projection
columns: spare_need_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES spare_needs(spare_need_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','resolved','cancelled','removed_history'))
contributor_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(contributor_count>=0)
planned_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(planned_quantity>0)
active_request_allocation_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active_request_allocation_quantity>=0)
active_local_allocation_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active_local_allocation_quantity>=0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: Need remains reusable despite prior allocations
contributor_count and planned quantity remain separate
removed_history is history-preserving removal, not deletion

tables.name: inventory_attention_projection
columns: attention_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
target_kind TEXT NOT NULL
target_id TEXT NOT NULL

attention_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(attention_kind IN ('spare_request_response_overdue','partial_rma_authorization','rma_assignment_conflict','receipt_bom_mismatch','task_outcome_consequence_pending','return_obligation_open','warehouse_final_decision_pending','warehouse_rejected_resend_required','proposal_review_required','stock_conflict'))
severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(severity IN ('info','warning','action_required','high'))
input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: rebuildable safety/attention projection only
unknown or unresolved states stay visible rather than becoming generic completion

required_indexes: all command/FK columns receive LLD-01 leading-prefix FK coverage
projection_rule: All current/attention rows are transactionally rebuildable from accepted Inventory facts and relationships. Projection recomputation never fabricates lifecycle evidence or mutates upstream Task/Communication authority.
